methodology: Rule-pack evaluation using the same condition/question-selection logic implemented in scripts/phase161-diagnosis-engine.mjs against the committed scenario JSON.
guardrails_verified: Profile install does not prove profile enablement.
Profile enablement does not prove carrier activation.
In-service does not prove data registration.
Data registration does not skip APN/DNN diagnosis.
Connected packet session does not hide explicit IP-link failure.
Data success plus voice failure does not skip IMS policy/registration.
Directional voice failure is localized only after both directions plus IMS/MMTel state are known.
5G+/NR Advanced display does not prove a CA/DC combination.
Generic runtime data success does not backfill APN/session/DNS internals.
